memoryReview.lesson: Avoid vellum, music staff and warm book layouts.
Avoid cobalt station controls and rehearsal charts.
Avoid field dossiers, angled parchment and military classification.
Avoid illustrated garden worlds and round pots.
Avoid museum tile board and brass mosaic trays.

references.observation: Official ImageOptim page foregrounds drag-and-drop, reduction of file bytes and removal of hidden metadata.
references.principle: Keep input and real savings legible rather than requiring a technical encoding tutorial.
references.application: Immediate drop well, row-level file sizes and total before/after meter.
references.avoid: Do not copy its identity or imply the same lossless algorithms.

references.observation: HandBrake documents presets for intended device and file-size quality, with resolution and frame-rate caps.
references.principle: Expose useful quality targets while hiding codec minutiae.
references.application: Three quality modes with concrete resolution/bitrate ceilings and a text note explaining realtime encoding.
references.avoid: Do not claim full HandBrake codec support or fixed target output sizes.

references.observation: 7-Zip separates archive packing from unpacking and documents format-specific support.
references.principle: Make archive operations explicit and disclose unsupported archive variants.
references.application: Create ZIP and Unpack ZIP are separate operations with exact unsupported variants shown.
references.avoid: Do not copy 7-Zip branding or claim RAR/7z/ZIP64 support.

concepts.medium: Opaque lightweight DOM/CSS workbench with a unique press icon and measured result bars.
concepts.composition: Fixed graphite vertical mode rail, wide file input/ledger, narrower size measurement panel; phone folds rail into a four-part horizontal selector.
concepts.interaction: Drop or pick files, choose compression strength, process each, save outputs.
concepts.motion: Short row insertion and measured bar transition when a real byte result completes.
concepts.rationale: Chosen: direct and distinctive utility with truthful file outputs and clear touch actions.

concepts.medium: Canvas fluid simulation representing each file as flowing pixels.
concepts.composition: Full-screen colorful current with floating control bubbles and no fixed file queue.
concepts.interaction: Swipe a media blob into a pipeline to set quality.
concepts.motion: Water flow, splashes and stretchy droplets.
concepts.rationale: Rejected: movement obscures bytes and increases battery consumption.

concepts.medium: Physical pseudo-3D drawer models in WebGL.
concepts.composition: Filing cabinet drawers separated by format with files on wooden shelves.
concepts.interaction: Drag objects into drawers and slam them shut to archive.
concepts.rationale: Rejected: complex handling for a basic filesystem workflow.

selection.reason: The measurable, tactile press metaphor increases task clarity without delaying processing or requiring GPU assets.

rejected.reason: Decorative simulation would hide technical outcomes.

tools.reason: Native HTML/CSS and self-authored SVG assets work offline and are editable.
Runtime feature detection governs video and HEIC conversion; report a clear unsupported state rather than faking a result.
Repository QA workflow and local Chromium available for checks.

assets.role: Original press-plate vector identity used in PWA/launcher.
assets.acceptance: At 48px two cream plates and orange compressed bar remain recognizable on graphite.
assets.integration: Local manifest and header symbol; no remote asset dependency.
assets.provenance: Authored specifically for Press using SVG paths and rectangles.

risks: Safari may not support MediaRecorder/Canvas.captureStream combination.
Unzipping a large archive needs memory and should cap output size.
On small phones the settings panel should remain reachable below the file queue.
comparisons: Folkarium page compositor versus Press mechanical rail.
Sin Guion technical console versus Press byte-measuring pane.
